# Wiki Emitter

The WikiEmitter is responsible for emitting a knowledge base in Markdown format conforming to the OKF specification. It regenerates pages based on changes detected in the knowledge representation, ensuring that only dirty pages are rewritten, while also maintaining a changelog and recent changes index.
